summary: Enhance your skills in data visualization and business intelligence with our comprehensive course. Learn to transform data into actionable insights effectively.
lede: Business intelligence and visualization training helps data professionals turn business questions into clear reports and dashboards. For foundation-to-intermediate learners who prepare, interpret, govern, or act on organizational data, it covers profiling and cleaning sources, building dimensional models, validating KPI measures with SQL, Power Query, and DAX, and designing interactive Power BI dashboards for operational audiences.
audienceIntro: This data visualization and business intelligence course suits professionals who prepare, interpret, govern, or act on organizational data. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who need practical dashboard and reporting capability without becoming software developers.
modules: Dimensional Modeling in a BI Tool
prerequisites: No programming background is required. You should have basic familiarity with spreadsheets, business reports, and performance measures. A working knowledge of tables, filters, and simple formulas will help you progress more quickly. You will use guided examples for SQL and DAX, and the course focuses on operational application rather than software engineering.
